TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms compliance with the RFP “Design, Development and One-Year Support of a Corporate Website and Customer Self-Service Portal” issued by State Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan, including submission, validity, and packaging instructions, and will submit the proposal by 30 June 2026 with 90-day bid validity.

Mandatory eligibility and statutory compliance: we are SECP incorporated and hold FBR NTN with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status. [CO-PROFILE] We hold valid ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications. [CO-PROFILE] We can furnish the required 2% bid security as a CDR/bank guarantee from a scheduled bank within our established bank guarantee facility. [CO-PROFILE]

Mandatory experience (not less than three web/software projects ≥ PKR 5M in last five years): our library evidences multiple qualifying software delivery engagements, including LMS Development (PKR 199M, completed 2022) [CAP-010], LMS Development (PKR 102M, completed 2023) [CAP-046], and ERP Implementation (PKR 93M, completed 2022) [CAP-050] (additional ERP implementations completed within the last five years are also evidenced). [CAP-002]

Scope compliance: we will deliver a secure customer portal with authentication and role-based access; integrate with State Life’s core policy system via REST APIs; integrate an online payment gateway; and deploy into the Corporation’s cloud environment. We will provide one-year warranty/support with defined response times aligned to our in-country support desk model and SLAs. [CO-PROFILE]

Partial areas and closure plan: while our evidence set does not explicitly document prior WCAG 2.1 AA conformance audits, we will address accessibility through WCAG-aligned design standards, testing (including screen-reader/keyboard-only checks), and documented compliance reports at UAT sign-off. We will also provide UX/UI design and a content-managed corporate website as required, with CMS workflows defined during discovery and validated through prototypes before build.
